text:
jamie: Hi — I accepted the GitHub org invite but I get 'You must enable 2FA' even though I enabled TOTP in settings. Also I don't see the client-sdk repo in the org. Who should I ping for repo access?

olivia: Hey Jamie — quick checks: did you enable 2FA on the same GitHub account/email we invited? Sometimes SSO/org membership shows pending until you re-login after enabling 2FA. What's the exact error message?

jamie: The message is: 'You must enable two-factor authentication to access redwood-inference'. I turned on TOTP under Settings → Security and the email matches the invite (jamie@redwood.com).

alex: Ping me — I can cancel/resend the invite. Also run this to see membership state if you have gh installed:```gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference --jq .state```

jamie: Ran it — output is "pending"

alex: OK I'll cancel and resend now. After I resend, accept the invite in the same browser where you're signed into GitHub. If that still fails, log out and log back in. Also, I'll add you to the eng-client team which has access to client-sdk. If you need write access, say so.

onboard-bot: Welcome jamie! Quick onboarding checklist: accept org invite, enable 2FA, join eng-client team, add SSH key or PAT for git. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding (internal). :tada:

raj: If you need repo-level write or admin, tag me with the repo name + reason and I'll approve the request.

olivia: Invite resent — check your inbox. If you still hit the 2FA notice after enabling, try a browser restart then accept. LMK and I'll escalate to GitHub org admins.

jamie: Accepted the invite, I can see redwood-inference org now but client-sdk still not visible for me.

alex: Added you to eng-client and granted write on client-sdk. Try a refresh or open https://github.com/redwood-inference/client-sdk directly. If you still can't clone, paste the git error.

jamie: I can see the repo now and cloned successfully. SSH key added and push worked. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:

alex: Great — you're in. If you run into any permission probs (CI, Actions access, deploy keys) ping me or @raj.

jamie: Closing out — all good on my end. Thanks all :smile:
